hints.title: Accumulating Building Distances
hints.text: Traverse from each building to empty land cells, recording cumulative travel steps and verifying all buildings can reach the site.

hints.title: Reachability Count Filtering
hints.text: Maintain reach_count[r][c] to ensure only empty land cells reachable by every single building are considered.

hints.title: Multi-Source Breadth-First Grid Expansion
hints.text: For every cell with building value 1, run BFS through empty land cells (0). Add steps to dist[r][c] and increment reach[r][c]. At the end, find minimum dist[r][c] where reach[r][c] equals total building count. If no such cell exists, return -1.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal BFS expansion from building sources accumulating Manhattan grid distances.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Searching from every empty land cell tests disconnected paths repeatedly in O(E * M * N) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Searching from buildings (typically B << empty lands) reduces searches significantly.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Filter for cells reachable by all buildings and return -1 if no mutual meeting point exists.
